summary: Completed live API and browser testing for homepage, booking, quote, sell-phone, FAQ, Android CTA, and mobile navigation.

minor.issue: LeadCreate accepts arbitrary type and unvalidated phone strings; current UI supplies valid values, but API contract has no field/value validation.

integration_issues.issue: submitLead marks the success state even when fetch receives a non-2xx response (fetch only rejects network errors), so backend failures can be presented as successful lead capture.

action_items: Handle non-OK /api/leads responses before showing success state.
Add Pydantic validation for lead type and phone format if strict API validation is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Lead submission does not inspect response.ok, creating a false-positive success UI on HTTP 4xx/5xx responses.
seed_data_creation: Created two quote/sell lead records through direct API testing and two additional records through UI testing, using TEST-prefixed model data where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live API root/status and POST /api/leads passed. Browser verified desktop hero, 10 service cards, WhatsApp booking URL with encoded message, required quote validation and success, sell valuation success, FAQ toggle, #app-download Android target, mobile menu, and no horizontal overflow. APK remains an in-page anchor because no external APK URL was provided.
rca of the issue: In App.js submitLead awaits fetch but never checks response.ok. Fetch resolves normally for HTTP errors, then the component unconditionally sets quoteSent/sellSent true. Mitigation: inspect response.ok, parse/display an error state, and only mark success for 2xx responses.
